data.inventory_scope: Loaded UPackage objects in the current Editor process only.
data.unloaded_package_note: Packages absent from the loaded UObject inventory were not inspected and are not classified as clean.
data.page_consistency_note: All pages with this inventory_id use copied records from one game-thread scan; request remaining pages within snapshot_lifetime_seconds.

plan.formula: -100*sin(pi*t)^2*cos(pi*abs(y-(1070+sin(2*pi*t)))/4)^2 within 2 vertices of curved centerline, else zero

data.scope: Isolated test maps only; creation/readback is limited to 4,194,304 samples, edit requests are chunks up to 1,048,576 samples, heightmap input chunks are limited to 32,768 samples, pending height plans are capped at 15 MiB, and each height job writes at most eight rows per editor tick. The estimated Forge-owned plan and stage height arrays stay within 16 MiB; Unreal texture source, collision, and derived-data memory are measured separately. Cancellation retains already applied rows. Heights are Edit Layer values, not merged heights.
